_comment: Sample limits file for the qemu-aarch64 smoke target. The Lane B build pipeline copies the variant-appropriate file to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. deputyctl reads from $DEPUTYOS_LIMITS_FILE, falling back to /etc/deputyos/limits.json, falling back to this dev path. Schema lives in deputyctl/src/limits.rs.

limitations.unblock: Pi 5 8GB or larger; or run model via cloud provider

limitations.reason: qemu emulation makes wake-word and TTS unworkably slow
WhatsApp Cloud webhook RSS exceeds standard tier headroom
